title: The product of two nonnegative constructed reals is nonnegative
statement: For constructed reals x0, x1: if 0 <= x0 and 0 <= x1 then 0 <= x0*x1.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.mul_nonneg : ((x0 : CReal) -> ((x1 : CReal) -> ((x2 : CReal.le CReal.zero x0) -> ((x3 : CReal.le CReal.zero x1) -> CReal.le CReal.zero (CReal.mul x0 x1)))))
